senses.gloss: f. (preced.) רוח ק׳ asthma, or incubus [or nervous prostration,] believed to be caused by a demon, Ben N’filim.
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Bekhorot 7:5">Bekh. VII, 5</cite> (<cite ref="Bekhorot 44b:11">44ᵇ</cite>) <he>רוח קצרית באה עליו</he> Mish. (Bab. ed. <cite ref="S01850"><he>קצרה</he></cite>) a person subject to asthmatic spells (is unfit for priesthood). Ib. 44ᵇ <he>רוח קצרות</he>, v. <cite ref="N00020"><he>נָאלָא</he></cite> II a. <cite ref="N01041"><he>נָפִיל</he></cite>.
